properties.displayName: ImageMagick: Memory Leak in wand option parser when providing invalid arguments
properties.description: ImageMagick: Memory Leak in wand option parser when providing invalid arguments
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "imagemagick" or Msg contains "memory" or message_s contains "imagemagick" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP | where count_ > 3 // GHADV-1641
